summary: The filing is an 8-K by Citigroup Commercial Mortgage Trust 2026-MFAM1, reporting the execution of an underwriting agreement and certificate purchase agreement for a commercial mortgage pass-through certificate securitization. The transaction involves the issuance of $706.575 million public certificates and $110.275 million private certificates, expected to close on July 29, 2026. The filing describes standard securitization mechanics, including the role of underwriters and the pooling and servicing agreement. This is a routine current report for an asset-backed securities issuance, not a special situation event.
